evidence_sufficiency: The paper and its refereed supplement are one scientific study, not two independent confirmations. Direct photographs, interpretive drawings, a clearly labeled comparative reconstruction and measured anterior anatomy are enough for this explicitly hypothetical scope.
rejected_depictions: The historical tarantula reconstruction and X-ray-derived supposed hidden fangs are obsolete and must not be used as anatomy.
originality: All geometry, palette, pose and simplified relief must be newly authored. Scientific figures are consulted, not traced into a mesh or republished.
